components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--accent, #34302c); color: var(--on-accent, #f7f6f3); font: 680 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #282624; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #805332); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A visible but quiet supporting action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2ded8); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--panel, #ffffff); color: var(--accent, #34302c); font: 680 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #34302c); background: var(--accent-soft, #eae5df); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #805332); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Solid labeled search and filter input.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Search restaurants<input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Cuisine, dish, or place"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink, #282624); font: 680 13px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9b2a9); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--panel, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #282624); font: 400 16px/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #34302c); outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #805332); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Playlist Chip
components.description: A compact playlist filter whose membership count stays explicit when other criteria narrow the visible queue.
components.html: 3 of 19 places
components.css: .ds-playlist-filter { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted, #66615c); font: 680 13px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip, .ds-show-all { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2ded8); border-radius: 10px; font: inherit; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--accent, #34302c); color: var(--on-accent, #f7f6f3); } .ds-show-all { background: var(--panel, #ffffff); color: var(--accent, #34302c); } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-show-all:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #34302c); } .ds-chip:focus-visible, .ds-show-all:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #805332); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Restaurant Order Ticket
components.css: .ds-ticket { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #34302c); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--accent-soft, #eae5df); color: var(--ink, #282624); box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(23,74,59,.09); } .ds-ticket h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 19px/1.05 "Newsreader", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ticket p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #66615c); font: 400 14px/1.4 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-score { display: grid; justify-items: end; color: var(--highlight, #91613c); } .ds-score small { color: var(--muted, #66615c); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Places, Map, and Pick remain visible at every viewport.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2ded8); border-radius: var(--radius-surface, 14px); background: var(--panel, #ffffff); } .ds-nav button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #66615c); font: 680 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button.active { background: var(--accent, #34302c); color: var(--on-accent, #f7f6f3); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #805332); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
FoodLog feels like a well-made restaurant journal: warm white pages, quiet charcoal structure, stone selection surfaces, restrained bronze highlights, and editorial type for the places and meals people want to remember. The interface stays calm so restaurant photography, names, and shared memories carry the experience.

The product is used repeatedly on phones while people decide where to eat and add memories at the table. Navigation, capture, and return transitions must therefore feel stable, interruptible, and familiar. Returning from a restaurant keeps the live Places list, its scroll position, and carousel state instead of visually rebuilding the screen.
keyCharacteristics: A compact rail keeps Places, Map, search, and Add immediately available.
Restaurant rows are compact editorial tickets with a reserved thumbnail, strong name, bubble metadata tags, and a clean inline rating.
Stone surfaces identify selection and grouped controls; porcelain and charcoal keep content quiet.
Food photography and friend opinions carry the detail view.
Charcoal is the structural brand color in the light theme; dark mode uses charcoal, elevated neutral surfaces, ivory type, stone support, and warm bronze.
Light and dark themes preserve the same hierarchy and component character.

rules.name: The Appetite Mark Rule
rules.body: Bronze stays rare. It identifies ratings, appetite, focus, or a consequential state rather than decorating routine controls.

rules.name: The Menu Voice Rule
rules.body: Labels state what people can do. Decorative uppercase, fake ticket numbers, and poetic microcopy are not part of the system.

rules.name: The Pass Surface Rule
rules.body: Card elevation replaces enclosing borders. Never stack a prominent outline and a shadow on a resting card.

dos: **Do** show real restaurant and dish photography as the primary visual material.
**Do** keep every existing workflow findable within the redesigned shell.
**Do** use Bronze only for appetite, focus, and consequential decision states.
**Do** provide complete loading, empty, error, disabled, and permission states.
**Do** keep gesture shortcuts optional and pair them with visible controls.
donts: **Don't** imitate aged paper, handwritten notebooks, receipt printers, or novelty restaurant decor.
**Don't** use a generic metric-dashboard hero or equal card grid.
**Don't** hide editing, Bookmarks, reviews, or playlist membership behind long press. Playlist membership is edited in Edit restaurant; rename and Trash stay on the playlist rail.
**Don't** animate frequent navigation or keyboard-driven actions.
**Don't** permanently remove shared content or associated media from the interface.
